_about: PHP and WordPress functions that no longer exist in a given version, for issue/compat.js. Same style as known-conflicts.json: every entry has a source URL and a claim phrase that the cited page must contain. An entry with "verified": false is NEVER matched by compat.js. Only functions that are really gone are listed, not merely deprecated ones (WordPress's get_currentuserinfo is deprecated but still defined, so it is not here). No WordPress-level entry is verified yet, so none is listed. The claim phrases below were read by hand on 2026-11-02; `npm run guard:verify-knowledge` is not extended to this file yet.

entries.verified_note: phrase found on the page on 2026-11-02: "This function has been DEPRECATED as of PHP 7.2.0, and REMOVED as of PHP 8.0.0."
